name: Apprise-api
tagline: Takes advantage of Apprise through your network with a user-friendly API. * Send notifications to more than 100 services. * An incredibly lightweight gateway to Apprise. * A production ready micro-service at your disposal. * A Simple Website to verify and test your configuration with. Apprise API was designed to easily fit into existing (and new) eco-systems that are looking for a simple notification solution.
description: Apprise-api Takes advantage of Apprise through your network with a user-friendly API. * Send notifications to more than 100 services. * An incredibly lightweight gateway to Apprise. * A production ready micro-service at your disposal. * A Simple Website to verify and test your configuration with. Apprise API was designed to easily fit into existing (and new) eco-systems that are looking for a simple notification solution.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/apprise-api:2.0.2@sha256:43bd5d9912aae31341b33cec9a08f137241ef2468f67f04dac2e41870ddfbeed
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      APPRISE_ATTACH_SIZE: ''
    ports:
      - target: 8000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/attachments
        target: /attachments
